@graph.name: openMCP (meok-cross-post)
@graph.description: One CLI to audit a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server against a 100-point rubric and cross-post it to every top directory: Smithery, Glama, MCPize, PulseMCP, the MCP Registry, and the Docker MCP Catalog. Pushes to the directories with public APIs (Smithery, MCP Registry) and prints an exact manual checklist for the rest.
@graph.keywords: mcp, model context protocol, smithery, glama, mcpize, pulsemcp, mcp registry, docker mcp catalog, directory, scorecard, audit, cross-post, openmcp, meok
featureList: Audit any MCP server repo 0-100 against a 5-category rubric (installability, server correctness, discovery, distribution, CI/CD & docs)
Cross-post metadata to the two directories with public APIs: Smithery and the MCP Registry (idempotent)
Generate exact manual-submission checklists for Docker MCP Catalog, Glama, MCPize, and PulseMCP
Generate a Docker MCP Catalog YAML template ready to PR
Metadata consistency pre-flight across smithery.yaml, server.json, glama.json, server-card.json, package.json
Local-only audit for PR CI plus a --network mode with GHCR / Smithery / MCP Registry probes
Also runs as an MCP server (audit_repo, cross_post_metadata, manual_checklist) over streamable-http
